body:
Source: repository maintenance audit, 2026-09-20 (no GitHub issue). Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea: `packages/tickets/lib/generation-descriptor.mjs` (351 lines, 179 of them comments; 12 exports: ADOPTION_RECORD_KEY, CONFIG_FILENAME, GENERATIONS_DIRNAME, SCHEMA_VERSION, MAX_CONFIG_JSON_BYTES, isLegacyGeneration, validateGenerationId, resolveGenerationDir, assertGenerationDirNotSymlinked, validateAdoptionRecord, readAdoptionRecord, resolveActiveGenerationPaths) has exactly one importer, its own test `packages/tickets/test/generation-descriptor.test.mjs:23` (479 lines). Its own comment at :101 says `this module has no consumers yet`. It landed in 8332b6e1 (2026-07-30) as the first slice of `.adlc/specs/manifest-key-hermeticity.md` Layer 3; no writer, verifier or CLI was ever routed through it, `.adlc/config.json` carries no `signing` record and `.adlc/manifest-generations/` does not exist. It is not re-exported from `packages/tickets/index.mjs` and not declared in `index.d.ts`, but it IS a public subpath: `packages/tickets/package.json:16` `"./lib/generation-descriptor.mjs": "./lib/generation-descriptor.mjs"`, published in @adlc/tickets 1.11.1. `git grep -n "@adlc/tickets/lib/generation-descriptor"` prints nothing, and the error codes INVALID_GENERATION_ID, GENERATION_DIR_UNSAFE and MALFORMED_ADOPTION_RECORD appear in no other file. Shipping 830 lines that nothing can reach, behind a public import path, is the defect.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/tickets`: `index.mjs` star-re-exports 28 lib modules (not this one); `package.json` `exports` has five keys: `.`, `./package.json`, `./lib/key-contract.mjs`, `./lib/generation-descriptor.mjs`, `./lib/durability.mjs`. The two surviving `./lib/*` subpaths are load-bearing: key-contract is imported by fleet, gate-manifest (5 files), prosecute, ticket-prune and ticket-sync; durability by `packages/gate-manifest/lib/key-ceremony.mjs:30`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/tickets` from the worktree root (plain `node --test`; the root runner picks package tests up by directory glob, so deleting or adding a test file needs no registry edit). The map line and the file must go in the same change: `scripts/test/release-artifact.test.mjs` (`the real repo ships every file its code imports`) packs every package and fails on an `exports` target that is missing from the tarball. Textual mentions of the module that remain after this change: a JSDoc cross-reference at `packages/gate-manifest/lib/key-ceremony.mjs:286` (see item 5) and the completed ticket shard T-01M2T81WYX7XCNPHGRH9E85DZW (history; the ticket store is add-only). If Layer 3 is ever resumed the module is recoverable with `git show 8332b6e1:packages/tickets/lib/generation-descriptor.mjs` and its test with `git show 051c1812:packages/tickets/test/generation-descriptor.test.mjs`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. FIRST add the new test file `packages/tickets/test/exports-map.test.mjs` and run it before touching anything else. It reads `../package.json` with `readFileSync(new URL('../package.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8')` and has exactly two tests. Test 1, the public surface is declared: `assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(pkg.exports).sort(), ['.', './lib/durability.mjs', './lib/key-contract.mjs', './package.json'])`. Test 2, every public lib subpath loads by package name: for each key of `pkg.exports` that starts with `./lib/`, `await import(pkg.name + key.slice(1))` resolves and the module has at least one export. At this point Test 1 MUST fail and the assertion diff MUST show `+   './lib/generation-descriptor.mjs'` as the only difference, and Test 2 MUST pass; if either is not so, stop and re-read this ticket. The file imports only `node:test`, `node:assert/strict` and `node:fs`: no repository walk, no source-text scanning, no `mkdtempSync`, no child process, no exported helpers. Commit it on its own with subject `test(tickets): declare the public subpath surface`.
2. THEN, in one commit: `git rm packages/tickets/lib/generation-descriptor.mjs packages/tickets/test/generation-descriptor.test.mjs` and delete line 16 of `packages/tickets/package.json`. Every other byte of `package.json` is unchanged: no version bump (releases are lockstep), and `files`, `bin`, `main`, `types` and the other four `exports` entries are untouched.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` reword the two comments that name the deleted test (search for `generation-descriptor`) so they name no file. In the JSDoc above `unremovedFixtures` the sentence becomes: `a file-level "does an rmSync appear anywhere" test passes a file whose only rmSync calls delete a subdirectory of the fixture so a symlink can take its place — setup, not cleanup — while every fixture root survives the run.` The comment inside the test `a same-file rmSync on a DIFFERENT binding does not launder a leak` begins `The shape that motivated per-binding pairing: rmSync deletes a` instead of naming the file. No assertion, fixture string or ALLOWLIST entry changes.
4. Regression guard: nothing else moves. `packages/tickets/index.mjs`, `index.d.ts`, `README.md`, `lib/trust-root.mjs` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/tickets.mdx` are NOT edited. The KNOWN BOUNDARY paragraph and the `--allow-unsigned` rationale in `lib/trust-root.mjs` do not mention this module, stay accurate after it is gone (adoption records are still not built), and belong to open ticket T-01M0TMRSQKGTNWZTFXBPQ2JHNB.
5. Do not edit anything under `packages/gate-manifest/`. `packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs` lists it in ENFORCEMENT_PREFIXES, so any non-test edit there changes the tier of this change. The sentence at `key-ceremony.mjs:286` will name a file that no longer exists; say so in the pull request description, as a dangling cross-reference that the gate-manifest key-ceremony cleanup owns.
6. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md` (entries are generated from commit subjects by `scripts/changelog.mjs`; the 1.8.0 entry is history) or `.adlc/specs/manifest-key-hermeticity.md` (it never names the module file). Pull requests are squash-merged, so the PULL REQUEST TITLE is the subject the changelog sees. Use exactly `refactor(tickets): remove the unreachable generation-descriptor module and its subpath export` for both the step 2 commit and the pull request title: `refactor` lands under "Changed", whereas `chore` subjects are dropped, and this removes a subpath that was published.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The public surface is declared and every public lib subpath loads. verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/exports-map.test.mjs` exits 0 with 2 passing tests (before step 2 the same command exits 1 on Test 1).
- AC2 Both files are gone. verify: `test ! -e packages/tickets/lib/generation-descriptor.mjs && test ! -e packages/tickets/test/generation-descriptor.test.mjs`
- AC3 The subpath no longer resolves and the two surviving subpaths still do. verify (from the worktree root, after `npm ci --ignore-scripts`): `node -e "import('@adlc/tickets/lib/generation-descriptor.mjs').then(()=>process.exit(1),(e)=>process.exit(e.code==='ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED'?0:2))"` exits 0, and `node -e "Promise.all([import('@adlc/tickets/lib/key-contract.mjs'),import('@adlc/tickets/lib/durability.mjs')]).then(()=>console.log('both ok'),()=>process.exit(1))"` prints `both ok`.
- AC4 No reference survives outside the ticket store and the one gate-manifest JSDoc. verify: `git grep -n "generation-descriptor" -- . ':!.adlc' ':!packages/gate-manifest/lib/key-ceremony.mjs'` prints nothing, and `git grep -n -e resolveActiveGenerationPaths -e assertGenerationDirNotSymlinked -e validateAdoptionRecord -e GENERATION_DIR_UNSAFE -- . ':!.adlc'` prints nothing.
- AC5 The package manifest changed by one deleted line only. verify: `git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD -- packages/tickets/package.json | tr -s "[:space:]" " "` prints `0 1 packages/tickets/package.json`.
- AC6 Package suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/tickets`
- AC7 Consumers and repo-level guards green. verify: `node --test scripts/test/release-artifact.test.mjs scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs scripts/test/type-declarations.test.mjs packages/gate-manifest/test/key-ceremony.test.mjs packages/gate-manifest/test/key-ceremony-cli.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/worker-deps.test.mjs`
- AC8 The change stays out of every enforcement and producer package and out of the files item 4 protects. verify: `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD -- . ':!.adlc'` lists exactly `packages/tickets/lib/generation-descriptor.mjs`, `packages/tickets/package.json`, `packages/tickets/test/exports-map.test.mjs`, `packages/tickets/test/generation-descriptor.test.mjs` and `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`.
- AC9 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 and prints `mutation-gate: no source files changed — nothing to mutate.` after naming each surviving changed file as not a mutable source type (the change leaves no mutable source file modified; that is expected here, not a gap).

OUT OF SCOPE: `readSecretLine` / `confirmCustody` and any other edit in `packages/gate-manifest/**`, including the JSDoc at `key-ceremony.mjs:286` and the `generate-key` messages that promise a later slice (separate change in an enforcement package). Any edit to `packages/tickets/lib/trust-root.mjs`, `packages/tickets/README.md` or `tickets.mdx`. Any change to `.adlc/specs/manifest-key-hermeticity.md` or to the status of ticket T-01M0TMRSQKGTNWZTFXBPQ2JHNB. Deduplicating `readBoundedJsonNoFollow` or any other helper between packages. A repository-wide importer scan or an exports check for any other package.
title: tickets: remove the unreachable generation-descriptor module and its published subpath export
